huggingface.summary: Learning deployable manipulation policies is bottlenecked by the scarcity of data that is both high-fidelity and scalable. huggingface.title: Rethinking Classifier-Free Guidance in On-Policy Diffusion Distillation

huggingface.title: A New Role for Relevance: Guiding Corpus Interaction in Agentic Search

huggingface.title: Data Pyramid for Embodied Manipulation
huggingface.summary: Multimodal foundation models learned to see and to speak by consuming the whole internet. huggingface.title: Mage-VL: An Efficient Codec-Native Streaming Multimodal Foundation Model

huggingface.title: Keep It InMind: Benchmarking the Implicit-Association Blind Spot in Agent Memory

Yet a screenshot is only a lossy rendering of the underlying program state, e.g., the files, application backends, and DOM that hold the task data. Different states can produce the same pixels, while code can inspect and modify that state directly. StateAct is a code-first, multi-agent harness built around this distinction. sorted_all.summary: LLM training is shifting from manual design and annotation to interaction-driven self-evolution.
